verdict.rationale: Formant documents its own device-configuration capabilities: you can export a device configuration to YAML or save it as a reusable template, and its APIs can configure devices programmatically. However, nothing shows that a template or configuration change is pushed to many robots at once, or that changes can be targeted by group. Device groups and tags appear only in Analytics, an adjacent feature that earns no credit here. missing for 10: documented bulk/simultaneous config push across a fleet, per-group or tag-based targeting of config changes, rollout status/verification, independent or hands-on corroboration.
